features: 【🔗 BLUETOOTH + 2.4GHz DUAL-MODE WIRELESS】Enjoy flexible wireless connectivity with both Bluetooth and 2.4GHz modes. Simply plug the included USB receiver into your device for automatic 2.4GHz connection or pair the mouse through Bluetooth, then conveniently switch between the two modes using the dedicated mode key.

【🎯 3-LEVEL ADJUSTABLE 800/1200/1600 DPI】Switch between 800, 1200 and 1600 DPI sensitivity levels using the dedicated DPI adjustment button to suit different tasks. Choose greater control for everyday office work or increase cursor sensitivity when navigating larger displays and documents. The keys are rated for up to 3 million operations.

【🔇 SILENT CLICK & COMFORTABLE DESIGN】Designed for quieter everyday working with 4D silent left and right keys and a comfortable touch feel. The symmetrical design is suitable for both left- and right-handed users, making Acer Flow a practical choice for work, study and everyday computing.

【🔋 500mAh RECHARGEABLE BATTERY – UP TO 1 MONTH USAGE】Forget the hassle of frequently replacing disposable batteries. Acer Flow features an integrated 500mAh rechargeable battery providing approximately 1 month of usage, with a specified charging time of approximately 3 hours for convenient everyday productivity.

【⚡ TYPE-C CHARGING & UP TO 10M WIRELESS RANGE】Stay connected comfortably across your workspace with a wireless working distance of up to 10 metres. The mouse supports convenient Type-C charging and comes with a Type-C charging cable. Its compact 100 × 60 × 38mm body weighs just 61g, making it convenient for office, home and travel use.
